title: The Living Spirit's Ascent and the Three Works of the Sphere
arc: After the Living Spirit completes his structuring of the worlds, he ascends and signals the King of Honor to turn the wheels — a cosmic purification that casts the Error/dragon down from the star-wheel into the sea, where Hyle's enthumesis fashions it into the zodiacal "prow" that thereafter performs three providential works: winnowing the natural, restraining the powers from free ascent or descent, and gathering all the discharged residue.
reading:
This teaching describes a single great moment in the cosmic drama of regeneration: the moment when the Living Spirit, having finished his initial ordering of "the works and the worlds," steps back from his building, ascends, and hands the next phase of purification over to a turning, judicial mechanism. The whole arc moves from a completed structure (the firmaments built) through a great purgative motion (wind, water, fire scattered, the star-wheel washed) to the establishment of a permanent ongoing instrument — the sphere/zodiac — that will continue the work of refinement throughout cosmic time.

The teaching opens with the Living Spirit standing fast upon "this earth" — the natural mind now ordered as ground — and giving a sign to the King of Honor, the Lord's truth in its judicial governing power over the firmaments. At this signal the three wheels are set in motion, and the Father of Life, "as he was about to go upward," washes the wheel of the stars and expels from it everything that was within. Read correspondentially: when the Divine has completed his structuring work in the natural, he initiates a discriminative motion in the heavens themselves. Wind (perception), water (natural truth), and fire (love) are scattered, blown upon, raised up, and washed forth — the three elements of the natural are stirred so that what is mingled in them can be separated. The Error and the corrupt "answering" of the three places-of-deceit — the deceits proper to water, darkness, and fire — are driven out, and a saltness and bitterness rises in the seas as the by-product of this purification: the natural mind in its receptive depth (the sea) takes on the residue of what has been cast out of the higher heavens.

The center of the teaching is the fall and re-fashioning of the dragon-Error. Cast down from the wheel, it is mingled inward with the counsels of the sea; and there its own enthumesis — Hyle as corrupt matrix — gathers it to its fellows, ripens it, and seals it within the boundary of the sea with the seal of moments and days and years and the character of the stars and zodiac-signs. What had been cast out of the heavens as evil is now stamped with the imprint of cosmic time. The icon, the seals, the faces, the teachings, the counsels — the entire equipment of the corrupt powers — is sealed into one body. The teaching gives its central analogy here: like a craftsman who takes the molds of many gold coins, melts them in fire, and casts them into a single icon bearing all those many seals and forms, so the sea, acting as Chief-Image-Painter and Chief-Architect (the corrupt counterpart of the Mother of Life and the Great Builder), fashions the prow of the sea — the zodiacal body — out of the dispersed corruption, in a likeness different from all the other bodies of the sea.

Then the teaching states explicitly that this prow, this sphere, is established for three works, and these three works are the spiritual point of the whole teaching. First, the sphere is made to winnow itself — to purify itself out of the burden it carries — just as the ten firmaments above were purified and the burden of the three places of dispersion was winnowed out. This is the doctrine that cyclic process in the natural (the wheel, the sphere, the rotation of the zodiac) is itself a purgative instrument: the turning of states under spiritual influence is how good is gathered out of evil in the lowest plane. Second, the sphere serves as fastening and guard for the wheel and the bound zodiac-signs — like an iron peg driven into the wheel upon the firmaments — so that when the powers of the wheel desire to rise upward they have no power to ascend, and when they take counsel for guile and seek to come down to the earth they cannot descend. The bound archons are restrained by the very sphere that was made out of their own residue, and additionally by the unsleeping watchers placed upon her, sifting her at every moment. The Holder principle is at work: divine restraint built into the cosmic order itself, using the corruption's own form as the bond that holds it. Third, the sea/sphere serves as pandocheion, the all-receiver — the gathering-place into which all the wind, water, fire, rivers, rains, Error and "metarrismos" (transformation) that come down upon the natural are poured. Whatever is discharged downward from the cosmic process is collected here, and in the breath of the prow the sea is drawn upward to fullness without itself moving from its place.

Read as one teaching, this is a doctrine about how the Lord uses the very debris of corruption as the instrument of ongoing purification. The Living Spirit does not merely build and depart; he hands the work to the King of Honor's judicial wheels, and the casting-down of the Error becomes the raw material from which the sphere is forged. That sphere then performs the three permanent functions by which the natural is held in regenerative order: it winnows itself (continual purification), it pegs the powers in place (restraint of evil from free movement up or down), and it receives all that flows downward (gathering of residue for further sorting). What looks from below like the binding wheel of fate is, in correspondence, the instrument by which mingled state is continually sifted, the proprium-powers held back from breaking forth, and the discharged falsities gathered for the final extraction. The analogy of the craftsman melting many coins into one icon shows the deeper logic: the many seals and forms of corruption are unified into a single bound body precisely so that they can be processed as a whole, in the cycles of cosmic time, until what is light in them is winnowed out and what remains is fixed.

Several gaps in the surviving text obscure details — particularly the exact identity of "the four" by which the Error is cast down, and the specific terms applied to the sphere's structure in the closing lines — but the spiritual movement is clear: the Living Spirit's three formative acts (ordering, ascending, signaling) issue in three permanent works of the sphere (winnowing, restraining, gathering), and together these constitute the providential mechanism of natural-mind purification under the governing truth of the King of Honor.

major_images.meaning: The operative Divine power, having built spiritual structure in the natural, hands the work of ongoing purification to the Lord's judicial truth governing the heavens

major_images.image: Washing the wheel of the stars and casting down its contents
major_images.meaning: Discriminative purification in which what is corrupt in the natural-rational order is separated and expelled downward into the receptive depth

major_images.image: The dragon-Error mingled into the sea and fashioned into a body by Hyle's enthumesis
major_images.meaning: Corrupt receptivity gathers the cast-down falsities and shapes them into a single bound form — the zodiacal sphere — sealed with the marks of cosmic time

major_images.image: The craftsman melting many gold coins into one icon of many seals
major_images.meaning: The unification of dispersed falsities into a single workable body so that they may be processed and refined together

major_images.image: The iron peg fastening the wheel and zodiac-signs
major_images.meaning: The Holder principle: the divine restraint built into the cosmic order that prevents the bound powers from ascending or descending at will

major_images.image: The sphere as winnower, peg, and pandocheion (all-receiver)
major_images.meaning: The three providential works of cyclic process: continual purification, restraint of evil powers, and gathering of all discharged residue

major_images.image: The unsleeping watchers placed upon the sphere
major_images.meaning: Vigilant divine truths that sift the natural at every moment, ensuring the sphere itself is continuously judged
